items.quote: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD's.
items.claim: Moses claims that spreading his hands unto the LORD will cause thunder and hail to cease, demonstrating divine dominion over the earth.
items.action: spread abroad hands unto the LORD
items.mechanism: spread abroad hands unto the LORD
